attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will create pupil dilation system.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetTargetCtrl: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Mirror: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- SetEyeMesh: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetEyeEdgeRing: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetIrisEdgeLoop: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetBlendShapeNode: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Template target ctrl examples: Eyes_Main_Ctrl, Head_Ctrl, Neck_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
